_about: Contact fields the larry template adds, over the API. Names, types and options are the source build's, read from the live account on Oct 17 2026.

The source build's aff_* fields are not here: the partner layer uses the standard build's fields instead (aff_category -> Partner Type, aff_partner_tier -> Partner Tier, aff_referred_by -> Referring Partner Name/ID, aff_referrals_count -> Referrals Sent, aff_signed_date -> Agreement Signed Date, aff_status -> pipeline stage). See spec/10-larry-template.md §10.3.
